title: Gujarat Tops India's Wind Energy Charts with 16,086 MW Installed Capacity
summary: Generates 33,706 million units (MUs) of wind power in FY26, contributing 1/3rd of India's total output.

blocks.content: Generates 33,706 million units (MUs) of wind power in FY26, contributing 1/3rd of India's total output.

items: Capacity Leader: Gujarat ranks 1st in installed wind capacity (16,086 MW) and annual wind generation (33,706 MUs).
National Share: Gujarat accounts for nearly one-third of India's total wind power output.
